title: wish.v1
description: One customer wish. Stored as a fenced ```yaml wish block in the wishes file (qf.yaml paths.wishes_file); this schema validates one block. The diagram is drawn from the wishes, and a constraint requirement may derive from one (derived_from: W-<n>). A unique ID across the file is a gate rule. A wish of kind behaviour must be realised by a diagram (diagram_wishes.v1); a wish of kind constraint need not.

statement.description: The wish in the customer's words, one sentence, on one line.

source.description: Who asked for it (a role, e.g. product owner, operations).

kind.description: behaviour (the default): realised by diagram elements, and each must be covered by a diagram's wishes file. constraint: a given such as a runtime or a database that no diagram can draw; it is exempt from diagram coverage and becomes a constraint requirement at SWE.1.
